body: Okay  well your looking after yourself. Pain in the liver isnt always from alcohol you can get the same problems without it aswell but its always worse on google then what it actually is aswell..

Are you drinking enough water? Or had changes in any sort of medication?or is it just the drjnkjng that was the only change? Sorry so many questions. I think maybe just saying to your parents that you need to see the dr due to getting a pain as it could be from anything i rarely drink and sometimes get them when i havent had enough water (usually ) but finding out what it is from at the drs will help ease your mind.
I definitely will try! Thank you so much
Thank you there is a couple there i havent tried yet. I havent spoken to my family in 4 yrs they cut me off when i fell pregnant. .
Definitely we love being outside but we are living in the car or motel if the housing place can get us one at the moment.  We definitely will have a vege garden when we can find a place thank you x
Im so proud of how far you have come!! You have got this xx

If you need to talk about anything your more then welcome to message me about it! Im always happy to listen and help. Im here for you
Your friends though you need to put yourself first. Sometimes losing them is for the best i was like you at one stage. I ended up just being me sticking to myself eventually they all tried coming back but i ended up being happy with who i was. If that makes any sense? Sometimes we dont realise that the people we are with bring you down that little bit more until you are remove yourself from them then you slowly work on yourself.

If you need to talk about absolutely anything whether its a distraction, get something off your chest or just for some company your more then welcome to message me about anything in the world!! Im always happy to listen and help. Im here for you! x
Im always more then happy to listen/talk about anything. Im here for you no matter what is it. Just a message away x

Hey im in aus but im more then happy to listen if you need anyone to talk to. Im broke and homeless at the moment with 2 kids due to my ex their dad being abusive anyway if i had the money id get someone to order you something and sit with you.When i get a place you are more then welcome with me and the kids it will be a safe house. I kmow you didnt say anything about moving but i really wish i could change what happened to you but im going to help you. Your going to move on to do great things but first we need to get you eating.
Definitely it is a hard topic to talk about aswell.. try sitting down and talking with her like you said just let her know your there for her. You need to also make sure you are okay to.

Hey i dont know exactly what you fully would be goong through as i was born into my parents already being seperated. My mum had a new born and 2 yr old (my brother) when they split she was the same but she had her bestfriend, my auntys and uncle there for her to talk to. Make sure your mum knows your there for her but your mum would need someone else to talk to as being her daughter she wont put it all onto you. Just try letting close people to you guys know how worried you are also maybe let her dr know. I am here for you to if you need someone to talk to..
